props.name: controller
props.description: The controller managing this component's state and behaviour. Bind to it to access the component's imperative API.

props.name: onfirstcreate
props.description: Fires when the component's controller is first created.

props.name: component
props.description: The component that is rendered by this widget.

props.name: draggability
props.description: The draggability of the widget.

props.name: resizability
props.description: The resizability of the widget.

props.name: componentProps
props.description: The props applied to the component rendered, if it has one.

props.name: transition
props.description: The transition configuration for this widget.

props.name: grabTrigger
props.description: The configuration for how pointer events should trigger a grab event on the widget. E.g. a long press.

props.name: resizeTrigger
props.description: The configuration for how pointer events should trigger a resize event on the widget. E.g. a long press.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: The minimum width of the widget in units. Defaults to 1, cannot be less than 1.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: The minimum height of the widget in units. Defaults to 1, cannot be less than 1.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: The maximum width of the widget in units. Defaults to Infinity, cannot be less than 1.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The maximum height of the widget in units. Defaults to Infinity, cannot be less than 1.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable identifier for this widget, used for persistence and layout import/export. Read when the widget is created.

props.name: type
props.description: The registry key used when creating this widget. Changing the prop does not recreate it.

props.name: x
props.description: The starting column (x-coordinate) of the widget. After creation, use moveTo() to move it.

props.name: y
props.description: The starting row (y-coordinate) of the widget. After creation, use moveTo() to move it.

props.name: width
props.description: The initial width of the widget in grid units. Changing the prop does not resize an existing widget.

props.name: height
props.description: The initial height of the widget in grid units. Changing the prop does not resize an existing widget.

props.name: metadata
props.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with this widget, carried through layout export/import.

props.name: class
props.description: The class names to apply to this widget. Either a class value, or a function deriving one from the widget's state.

props.name: children
props.description: The content rendered within the widget.

properties.name: target
properties.description: The target this widget is under. Undefined until the widget is dropped in the board.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: The DOM element bound to this widget.

properties.name: isShadow
properties.description: Whether this widget is a shadow dropzone widget.

properties.name: isGrabbed
properties.description: Whether this widget is grabbed.

properties.name: isResizing
properties.description: Whether this widget is being resized.

properties.name: dropRejected
properties.description: Whether the widget is being grabbed or resized over a target that cannot accept it where it is: the drop would be rejected on release and the widget would return to where it came from.

properties.name: isInterpolating
properties.description: Whether the widget is currently animating to a new position or size, e.g. mid drop flight. Useful for styling that should only apply at rest, such as hover effects that would otherwise fire as the widget lands under the pointer.

properties.name: currentAction
properties.description: When the widget is being grabbed, this contains information that includes its position, size and offset. When this is null, the widget is not being grabbed.

properties.name: draggable
properties.description: Whether the widget can move at all: its `draggability` is not `'none'`. Read-only; set `draggability` to change it.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes this widget from its target and board. Fires the board's `onWidgetDelete` and `onLayoutChange`.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.type: (options: { target?: FlexiTargetController; x?: number; y?: number }) => boolean
methods.description: Moves this widget through the controller API, with no user interaction: to a position in its own target, to another target (at a position, or wherever that target's grid puts it), or both. Runs the grid's placement rules but not `canDrop`, which is for user drops. Fires `onLayoutChange`.
